name: Compress a dead query to its named terms
when: a five-term query returns nothing relevant twice
shape: keep the three terms that are proper names or exact phrases; drop the concept words
ingredients: the query's terms, marked which are names
yields: the page the concept words had pushed out of reach
misses: a query whose subject genuinely has no named handle
origin: the Reporter's measured rule (its retrospective seat, 139 queries)
